verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
My life will always honour Christ
Whether I live or die

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
I belong to Him
He bore my sin
I owe this life to my saving King

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
Hallelujah, I am not my own
You are in control, Hallelujah

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
For me to live is Christ
And to die is gain

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
No matter what price I pay
I choose to give this life away

verse.name: b1
verse.lines: Only by the cross I am saved
